headline: Marinade Native protocol with 9 on-chain contracts/accounts identified on Solana; no smart contract logic (uses native staking delegation)

findings.text: Solana explorer search yielded mSOL token and governance-related addresses; Marinade Native addresses surfaced from official documentation
Official deployments doc at https://docs.marinade.finance/developers/contract-addresses lists all 9 primary addresses with roles and authorities
No audit PDFs pinned in protocol.audit_links; FAQ references audits by Neodyme and Ackee Blockchain but PDFs not linked in per-protocol context

protocol.github is null; discovered GitHub repos via search results (marinade-finance/liquid-staking-program, marinade-finance/solana-program-library, marinade-finance/tokadapt, marinade-finance/voter-stake-registry); Marinade Native uses PDAs (program-derived accounts) with no mutable private keys
Single chain (Solana) — no cross-chain variants to enumerate
No factory pattern; Marinade Native is a singleton proxy controlling stake delegation authorities
Identified role taxonomy: proxy (Marinade Native proxy), staker_authority (delegation control), admin/upgrade_authority (Marinade Council 4/7), governance (DAO/Realm), token (MNDE)
All 9 addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to https://docs.marinade.finance/developers/contract-addresses with specific role and authority citations

rationale.verdict: Discovery slice catalogues 9 primary on-chain addresses across Marinade Native, supporting liquid staking, governance, and token infrastructure on Solana mainnet-beta. Marinade Native itself is a stateless delegation proxy with no contract code; control is exercised via Marinade Council (4/7 multisig) and Ecosystem multisig (6/13). All addresses sourced from official documentation and cross-checked with Solana explorer.

evidence.shows: Official deployed contracts list for Marinade on Solana, including Marinade Native Staking proxy (mnspJQyF1KdDEs5c6YJPocYdY1esBgVQFufM2dY9oDk), liquid-staking-program, governance, token, and referral contracts; lists upgrade and admin authorities for each

Marinade Native protocol overview: does not rely on smart contract, leverages native Solana stake account structure with delegation authority; users retain custody; no deposit/ongoing fees; staker can revoke delegation at any time

Marinade Native authorities are PDAs derived from proxy contract with no private keys; controlled and can be changed by Marinade's Council (implied 4/7 structure); two authorities: stake authority for delegation, exit authority for unstaking
Main documentation site with links to Contracts & Tokens Addresses page and deployment information; Marinade is a stake automation platform for Solana

Marinade governance structure: 6/13 ecosystem multisig (contract upgrades), 4/7 council multisig (mSOL-SOL liquidity and parameters), 4/7 council budget vault; Marinade Native introduced July 2023 with stake authority only (no withdraw authority); no management fee
Official website confirming Marinade Native and Liquid staking offerings; audited by 5 security firms; governed by MNDE DAO; SOC 2 Type I & II certified

protocol_metadata.about: Marinade Native is a non-custodial staking protocol on Solana that allows users to stake SOL while retaining full custody and withdrawal authority. Introduced in July 2023, it leverages native Solana stake account structures rather than smart contracts, with automated delegation to top-performing validators through Marinade's delegation strategy. Users create stake accounts in their wallets and delegate management to Marinade's protocol-derived authority accounts, avoiding smart contract risk while maintaining competitive staking rewards.
